summary: The change replaces the not-implemented stub for DataView.prototype.getFloat64 with a direct call to the shared helper get_view_value(agent, this, byteOffset, littleEndian, ElementType::Float64). It maps spec step 1 (view = this), step 2 (absent littleEndian passed as undefined, which GetViewValue's ToBoolean turns into false, the same result as the spec's explicit false), and step 3 (return ? GetViewValue(...) with float64). No branches key on test inputs, no errors are swallowed, and no values are invented. The only other edit is renaming the unused new_target parameter to _new_target, which is needed to avoid an unused-variable warning. The 36 new passing tests fit a change that delegates to a shared helper. I could not read get_view_value itself, so I am relying on the build and test results for its correctness; the diff does not show it being changed.
notes_for_next_attempt: No defects found in this diff. Its correctness depends on crate::support::typed_array::get_view_value implementing GetViewValue fully (RequireInternalSlot, ToIndex, ToBoolean, IsViewOutOfBounds, RangeError check, GetValueFromBuffer). That helper was not part of this diff and I could not inspect it. Worth a check if other DataView getters rely on it.
